info.title: UniCAS Console and Platform Access API Proposal
info.summary: Discussion contract for platform access and affected App administration workflows.
info.description: Proposal subset only; existing clients and server contracts must migrate together. Read projections own complete resources; writes return minimal receipts or 204 with the mutated resource ETag. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds. See ApiDesign.md for wire conventions and invitation/session rules. This document does not replace the generated UniCAS App Administrator API.

get.description: Returns immutable Principal identity, display Profile, effective platform access, and visible App memberships.

post.description: Requires current apps.create authority. Creates the App and grants the caller its first equal-authority App membership.

patch.summary: Update, suspend, or restore an App
patch.description: Conditionally updates App metadata or status. Suspension blocks every Space data-plane operation while preserving App control-plane recovery access.

get.description: Lists invitation records without bearer tokens or accept URLs. Effective expiry is reconciled consistently with acceptance and revocation.

post.description: Creates a short-lived single-use invitation for equal App administrator membership. emailConstraint remains optional; only constrained invitations can admit an otherwise unadmitted Principal through the login continuation.

201.description: Invitation created; acceptUrl contains the only returned bearer token

delete.description: Transitions pending unexpired state to revoked. Repeating with the current revoked ETag is a 204 no-op; a stale ETag is always 412. Accepted or expired state returns 409. Retains the record and audit history.

post.description: Consumes the invitation for the matching token-bound Google OIDC session, creates App membership, and rotates the session. An unconstrained invitation requires prior full admission; a constrained invitation additionally checks verified email. Returns only the App identifier for navigation.

200.description: Invitation accepted and session rotated; only the destination App identifier is returned

post.description: Creates a candidate inspection without changing the currently active production issuer.

put.summary: Activate or replace the production OAuth issuer
put.description: Atomically selects a verified candidate. Initial activation requires If-None-Match: *; replacement requires the current external issuer ETag in If-Match. Supply exactly one: neither is 428, both or malformed input is 400, a failed precondition is 412. Never use the App or inspection revision. The old issuer remains authoritative until commit.

patch.summary: Activate or disable the managed issuer
patch.description: Controls new managed capability issuance independently from the production issuer.

get.description: Searches the platform access projection over immutable Principal identity, Profile metadata, authority, and App membership counts.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Display name, email, or subject search.

200.description: Principal detail with read-only App memberships. revision belongs only to access state; this composite projection has no ETag.

get.description: Returns only the access resource and its strong ETag, excluding Profile and membership projections that change independently.

patch.summary: Change platform authority or access status
patch.description: Atomically replaces supplied access fields. Blocking overrides all platform authority and App membership admission without deleting them.

409.description: The mutation would remove the final Platform Admin or block the caller

200.description: Snapshot-bound invitation page without bearer tokens

post.description: Creates a short-lived verified-email invitation carrying one or more platform authorities.

201.description: Invitation created; acceptUrl contains the only returned bearer token

delete.description: Transitions pending unexpired state to revoked. Repeating with the current revoked ETag is a 204 no-op; a stale ETag is always 412. Accepted or expired state returns 409. Retains the record and audit history.

post.description: Consumes a matching invitation-limited session, binds authority to immutable Google Principal identity, rotates the session, and grants full admission.

204.description: Invitation accepted and session rotated; no response body. Read /admin/me to load current effective access.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Exclusive createdAt lower bound in Unix epoch milliseconds, not an event ID. Results sort by createdAt descending then eventId descending; use the opaque cursor for continuation.

adminSession.name: __Host-unicas_admin
adminSession.description: HttpOnly same-origin full administrator session. Current server-side authority is re-evaluated.

invitationSession.name: __Host-unicas_admin
invitationSession.description: Invitation-limited session bound to one invitation and token hash. It is not a general administrator session.

ETag.description: Strong ETag containing the exact current integer revision.

PrincipalRef.name: principalRef
PrincipalRef.description: Opaque API reference; authoritative identity remains issuer plus subject.

InvitationToken.name: token
InvitationToken.description: Single-use bearer token. Treat as a secret and never log it.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag of the resource being mutated. Checked before no-op handling. Missing is 428, malformed is 400, mismatch is 412.

IssuerIfMatch.name: If-Match
IssuerIfMatch.description: Required for replacement: current external issuer ETag, not App or candidate revision. Mutually exclusive with If-None-Match.

IssuerIfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IssuerIfNoneMatch.description: Required for initial activation when no external issuer exists. Mutually exclusive with If-Match; concurrent creation fails with 412.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key scoped to Principal, operation, and parent resource. Exact normalized-input retries replay the original receipt and ETag after current authorization checks; changed input is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Invitation replay is encrypted, expires no later than the invitation, and cannot recover consumed, expired, or revoked invitations (409 INVITATION_NOT_PENDING).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque snapshot-bound continuation cursor; keep filters and order unchanged, and recheck current authorization on every page.

OpaqueId.description: Opaque resource identifier or Principal reference. Domain is determined by the field name; never a display label or bearer token.

Revision.description: Exact version of the owning mutable resource, never a cross-resource or snapshot version.

StrongETag.description: Quoted canonical decimal Revision. Wildcards, weak tags, leading zeros, and tag lists are not accepted.

PaginationCursor.description: Opaque snapshot-bound cursor, not a resource identifier or timestamp.

EmailConstraint.description: Verified-email constraint normalized using the existing invitation email comparison. Not a durable authorization identity.

PlatformAuthorities.description: Authority set. Request order is irrelevant; responses use enum declaration order. An empty array removes all platform authority.

PlatformAccessFields.description: Reusable fields, closed at each response projection with unevaluatedProperties. Profile and memberships are not versioned by this revision.

CreateAppMemberInvitationRequest.description: Omit emailConstraint for an unconstrained invitation; it cannot bootstrap an unadmitted Principal. Requests do not use null to mean omitted.

CreateInvitationResponse.description: Shared App and platform invitation creation receipt. The ETag header carries the invitation revision; no resource, request fields, or token field are echoed.

challenge.description: Exact UTF-8 payload to sign as compact JWS; never decode and reserialize before signing.

InspectOAuthIssuerResponse.description: Only candidate identifier, computed discovery URLs for review, exact proof payload, expiry, and eligible kid/algorithm choices. Does not repeat the request issuer or path App ID, export captured public JWKs, or expose an unrelated mutable-resource revision.

RevisionUpdated.description: Mutation succeeded. No response body; ETag is the new revision of the mutated resource. Read its GET representation when refreshed display data is needed.

PlatformAccessRequired.description: No current full platform admission, or access is blocked

AppMembershipRequired.description: Current Principal is not an App member

InvitationSessionRequired.description: A matching invitation-limited session is required

InvitationNotPending.description: Invitation is accepted, expired, or revoked

PreconditionRequired.description: A concurrency precondition is required: If-Match for an existing resource, or If-None-Match: * for initial external issuer activation

RevisionMismatch.description: If-Match does not match the owning resource revision, or If-None-Match: * failed because the external issuer already exists

IdempotencyConflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT when a key was reused with different input; INVITATION_NOT_PENDING when an invitation receipt can no longer be replayed

IssuerConflict.description: Issuer candidate conflicts with current state or global uniqueness
